title: Forostar
hint: the Northlands, rocky and least fertile; Sorontil and Ondosto

title: Andustar
hint: the Westlands; Andúnië, Oromet, fir-woods in the north

title: Hyarnustar
hint: the South-west lands; vineyards and great cliffs

title: Orrostar
hint: the Eastlands; grain and northern hills

title: Mittalmar
hint: the Inlands, raised pasture-land around the Meneltarma

title: Arandor
hint: the Kingsland, the eastern Mittalmar with Armenelos and Rómenna

title: Emerië
hint: the sheep-pastures of the south-west Mittalmar; home of Erendis

title: Nísimaldar
hint: the land of fragrant evergreen trees around Eldalondë and the Bay of Eldanna

title: Hyarastorni
hint: approx: the sheep-lands of Hallatan, kinsman of Aldarion, near Emerië
